formal_statement: ∀ (s : ℕ → ℕ) (L : Language Bool), L ∈ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.SIZE s ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ f : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool, (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, f x = true ↔ List.ofFn x ∈ L) ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n f (s n)
plain_statement: A language is in SIZE(s) exactly when, at every length n, its slice as a Boolean function has a circuit with at most s(n) gates. A bridge between the two definitions, by unfolding; needed to turn a P/poly bound for a language into a circuit for one function in L-meta-016.
title: SIZE and HasCircuitSize agree on every slice of a language
